title: Overly Permissive Sudo Configuration

references.name: MITRE ATT&CK - T1548.003 Sudo and Sudo Caching

description: The sudoers configuration grants users the ability to run commands as root in an unsafe manner, for example NOPASSWD access, wildcards, or permission to run binaries that can spawn a shell or write arbitrary files. A low-privileged local user can leverage these grants to escalate to root.
businessImpact: Critical --- misconfigured sudo rights allow a standard user to obtain full root privileges on the host.
remediation:
- Grant sudo rights only to specific, non-shell-spawning commands and avoid wildcards.
- Remove NOPASSWD except where strictly justified and documented.
- Avoid allowing editors, interpreters, or archive tools that enable shell escapes.
- Audit sudoers regularly and centralize privileged access with logging.
